appearance_facts.fact: The blue solid line (left axis) is positioned in the upper half of the plot area.
The red dashed line (right axis) is positioned in the lower half of the plot area.
The blue marker is visually higher on the page than the red marker.
The blue line is descending from left to right, while the red line is ascending from left to right.
The blue and red lines intersect, with the red line crossing above the blue line.
